test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 18 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. The shopman was very interested in selling this creamy box to her as he would gain a big margin.

B. The man on the counter showed her 'an exquisite little enamel box' with a very fine glaze as if baked in cream.

C. As the box was too expensive, priced twenty - eight guineas, she asked the shopkeeper to keep it for her.

D. She went inside a little antique shop in Curzon Street. This was the usual shop where the shopkeeper was ridiculously fond of serving her.
solution:
The correct answer is "**DBAC.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph is about a woman visiting an antique shop and being shown an expensive enamel box by the shopkeeper.
 
 
• **Thus, the introducing sentence will be sentence D. It will be followed by the sentence B.**
 
 
 
• Further, the shopman is eager to sell the box as he would make a big profit.
 
 
• Thus, sentence A will follow sentence B.
 
 
 
• The woman cannot afford the box but asks the shopkeeper to keep it for her.
 
 
• Therefore, sentence C will come at the end of the passage.
 
 
 
• The paragraph is arranged in chronological order, starting with the woman entering the shop and ending with her asking the shopkeeper to keep the box.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
